articles.title: Russia Hacked Routers to Steal Microsoft Office Tokens
articles.summary: Microsoft patches a biblical 167 vulnerabilities including a SharePoint zero-day and Windows Defender's 'BlueHammer' flaw. At this rate, Patch Tuesday is becoming Patch Apocalypse.

articles.title: Real estate giant confirms vishing incident as ShinyHunters and Qilin both come knocking
articles.summary: Fresh Linux 'CopyFail' vulnerability gets weaponized faster than you can say 'responsible disclosure.' CISA warns attackers are already cashing in on this reliable root exploit.

articles.title: DAEMON Tools Supply Chain Attack Compromises Official Installers with Malware
articles.summary: Apache HTTP/2 vulnerability CVE-2026-23918 delivers DoS with a side of potential RCE. Because apparently even web servers need to be more exciting these days.

articles.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: AI-Powered Phishing, Android Spying Tool, Linux Exploit, GitHub RCE & More
articles.summary: Wiz researchers unearth 20-year-old PostgreSQL vulnerabilities that have been hiding in pgcrypto like digital fossils. Some bugs age like fine wine, others like radioactive waste.

articles.title: EFF and 18 Organizations Urge UK Policymakers to Prioritize Addressing the Roots of Online Harm
articles.summary: Germany doxes 'UNKN,' the elusive mastermind behind REvil and GandCrab ransomware empires. Daniil Shchukin's face-reveal tour includes 130+ acts of computer sabotage.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, April 2026 Edition
articles.summary: Scattered Spider's 'Tylerb' pleads guilty to wire fraud after SMS phishing campaigns. Another cybercrime legend trades keyboard clicks for prison uniforms.

articles.title: EFF Submission to UK Consultation on Digital ID
articles.summary: EFF calls for dismantling the 'turnkey totalitarian state' that NSA whistleblower William Binney warned about. Because surveillance empires don't discriminate based on who's holding the keys.

articles.title: Getting Digital Fairness Right: EFF's Recommendations for the EU's Digital Fairness Act
articles.summary: EFF challenges UK's digital ID scheme proposals, warning against creating another government backdoor dressed up as convenience. Virtual IDs, physical surveillance.

articles.title: China-Linked UAT-8302 Targets Governments Using Shared APT Malware Across Regions
articles.summary: DAEMON Tools supply chain attack serves malware through digitally signed installers from the official website. When even your mounting software gets compromised, nothing is sacred.

articles.title: Your work apps are quietly handing 19 data points to someone
articles.summary: French authorities arrest 15-year-old over France Titres breach affecting 12-18 million government records. Gen Z hacker proves age is just a number in the data liberation game.
